certifications.name: Claude Academy
certifications.notes: Free course catalogue covering Claude, AI fluency, Claude Code, API development, and Model Context Protocol. A free Claude account is sufficient to save progress and earn course completion badges. This entry does not include Anthropic's separate proctored Claude certification exams.

certifications.name: Cisco Networking Academy — Free Course Catalogue
certifications.notes: Catalogue of free, self-paced Cisco Networking Academy courses spanning networking, cybersecurity, software development, data science, and IT support. Eligible introductory and career-oriented courses may award free digital badges upon successful completion. This entry covers the course catalogue only; individual course access and badge eligibility vary. Course completion badges are distinct from formal Cisco professional certifications, which often require paid examinations.

certifications.name: EC-Council — Free Cybersecurity Courses for Beginners
certifications.notes: Collection of free EC-Council cybersecurity courses for beginners. Some courses require a final assessment. This entry covers free beginner courses only and does not include paid EC-Council certification exams or paid Essentials programs.

certifications.name: ScholarHat — Free Courses
certifications.notes: Free course catalogue spanning programming, AI, cloud computing, databases, and DevOps. Not all courses necessarily award a certificate; certificate availability and any associated costs should be verified per individual course.

certifications.name: IBM SkillsBuild — Free Learning and Digital Credentials
certifications.notes: Free learning platform offering courses in AI, cybersecurity, data analytics, cloud computing, and professional skills. Eligible courses and learning pathways may award IBM-branded digital credentials; individual credential eligibility, registration, assessment, or program-participation requirements apply. This entry does not imply that every course awards a credential.

certifications.name: HP LIFE — Free Courses
certifications.notes: Free online courses in business, AI, digital skills, finance, marketing, entrepreneurship, and professional development. Courses award a free certificate of completion. These completion certificates are not formal professional certifications.

certifications.name: Forage — Free Virtual Job Simulations
certifications.notes: Free, self-paced virtual job simulations created with employers. Participants complete practical tasks based on real-world roles. Many simulations offer a completion certificate, but availability varies by simulation. These completion certificates are distinct from formal professional certifications or accredited qualifications.
